question: Where is the nearest golf course found with respect to Dupp & Swat, Charlotte, NC?
sql: WITH target_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Dupp & Swat%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Charlotte%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT name, distance_meters FROM ( SELECT poi_name AS name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM target_location)::geography) AS distance_meters, p.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM target_location) AS knn_order_distance FROM pois AS p WHERE p.leisure = 'golf_course' UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, ST_Distance(pk.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM target_location)::geography) AS distance_meters, pk.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM target_location) AS knn_order_distance FROM parks AS pk WHERE pk.leisure = 'golf_course' ) AS combined_golf_courses ORDER BY knn_order_distance LIMIT 1;
